problem.text: Find f'(x) for f(x)=2(1-ln x/x), analyze sign, draw variation table.

solutionSteps.explanation: Quotient rule: (u/v)' = (u'v - uv')/v²

chunks.text:
ស្វែងរក k ណែ 2(1-ln x/x)=k មានដំណោះ ។ ដោយ min f = f(e)=2-2/e≈1.3 នោះ k≥1.3 ។ ដូចេ្នះ k≥2-2/e ។
ផ្ទៃក្រឡា (C) អំឡើង (x'Ox) ពី x=1 ដល់ x=e:
S = ∫₁ᵉ 2(1-ln x/x) dx = ∫₁ᵉ (2-2(ln x)' ln x) dx = [2x - ln²x]₁ᵉ = (2e-1)-(2-0) = 2e-3 ។
chunks.normalizedText: Equation 2(1-ln x/x)=k has solutions iff k≥ minimum of f = 2-2/e ≈ 1.3. Area under C between x=1 and x=e: S = ∫₁ᵉ f(x)dx = 2e-3.
